callers.reason: All criteria met. The card service (cards.list) failed as evidenced by the system events. The assistant correctly stated it could not perform the operation and informed the user of the transfer to a customer representative. It did not invent any debt data or return to the main menu. The call ended properly with an assistant-initiated end call.

callers.name: same last four digits
callers.reason:
The assistant failed to meet the success criteria for the following reasons: 
1. The assistant asked for the full card number (Messages 6, 14, 20) instead of completing the process with the 4 and 6-digit steps specified in the criteria.
2. The assistant failed to read the debt of the 'Yıldız Pratik' card requested by the user; it instead read the debt of the 'Yıldız Tasarım' card (Message 24).
3. The assistant repeated the debt statement for the 'Yıldız Tasarım' card in Message 28, even after the user stated they did not want any further action, which indicates poor conversation flow.
4. While the assistant only spoke 4 digits of the card number (8870), it did not successfully resolve the 'Yıldız Pratik' card as intended by the flow described in the criteria.
